R01.evidenceBoundary: Independent GUID, terminal closure and new-GUID subsequent exposure are actual repository/controller tests. Qualified repeated-source reuse follows the Principal decision; no unobserved lifecycle events inferred.

R02.evidenceBoundary: Immutable persisted instances/versions, exact version URI+resolution, immediate same-Account/Position predecessor and recursive interpretation tested. Graph chronology arises from immutable instances plus current-predecessor admission, not a lifecycle engine.

R03_R04_R05.evidenceBoundary: Current-cut quantity conservation, affected Position/Construction propagation and aggregate fungible coverage tested. Unknown cut quantities/terms remain qualified; no specific-share reservation or buying-power conclusion.

R06.evidenceBoundary: Purpose/type/Account/subjects/completeness checks and adverse association probes tested. Native complex parent/child corroboration proves only that instruction relationship. Raw holdings similarity/optional order-id does not prove opening or current Position membership.

R07_R08_R09.evidenceBoundary: Production recognizer/evaluator with exact recursive ratios, standard-term compatibility, debit/credit/unit tests, unequal BWB tails, generic fallback and actual Java/projectLive replay. Finite supported catalog; no39-model acceptance claim.

R10_R18.implementation: PortfolioSources, PortfolioSnapshots, PortfolioFidelityAdditionalCustody, PortfolioCashCustody, PortfolioMarketSources, PortfolioTastyMarketSources, PortfolioOptionReferenceSources, PortfolioOptionDefinitions, PortfolioReferenceEnrichment
R10_R18.tests: PortfolioContractIntegrationTest, PortfolioHttpTest, PortfolioFidelityFactsTest, PortfolioUnquantifiedCustodyTest, PortfolioCashCustodyTest, PortfolioOptionReferenceTest, PortfolioMarketReadThroughTest
R10_R18.evidenceBoundary: Independent retained custody/source originals, reported source dialect/capital, missing quantity and positive/negative/unknown settled cash; actual per-source clocks and current-cut Instant selection tested.

R11_R12_R13_R14.evidenceBoundary: Actual HTTP/User grants and direct/summary/expanded/history/source/Audit/constituent negative cases; private Order/market clocks, warnings and analytics redacted. Full application wiring also tested; installed grants remain unverified.

R15.evidenceBoundary: Native instructions/fills and exact source transaction correlation tested, including absent historical multiplier/fees. Working instructions do not alter exposure. Group corroboration never creates a fill or Position.

R16_R17.evidenceBoundary: Three original/current/cumulative specimens and incomplete history, history preservation, protective applicability, dimensions and cost magnitudes tested. Documented interval is not automatically lifetime history; tax basis/realized attribution stay source-qualified.

R19.evidenceBoundary: Real application and controller error/status/header behavior; partial imports/source refresh failure remain distinct from valid-but-incomplete financial reads. No body retained when no valid source body exists.

sourceTruthBoundaries: No live brokerage or installed production/grant verification. All source tests are retained repository or explicitly synthetic loopback fixtures.

No native-source guarantee has been asserted for universal Position membership, original occurrence, interruption-free holding, split/recombine or complete lifetime history. Unsupported association/evaluation remains UNKNOWN/INCOMPLETE and inspectable. This implements the accepted evidence boundary, not invented events.
Broker-reported valuations retain their dialect. Missing/adjusted/mixed-horizon/unknown basis and historical observations never become exact gross/net or tax-basis conclusions.
Portfolio/Execution roots, universal split/recombine, discretionary basis policy and operator-association tooling remain explicitly open/deferred, not selected by implementation.
